Benefits future contributors and reviewers of wallet loading code, who get one consistent error-handling pattern instead of scattered bilingual_str& and vector<bilingual_str>& parameters.

result.summary: This PR converts wallet loading functions across the wallet, RPC, GUI, and interfaces layers (CreateWallet, LoadWallet, RestoreWallet, MakeDatabase, MakeSQLiteDatabase, and related helpers) to uniformly return util::Result instead of a mix of bilingual_str& error and vector<bilingual_str>& warnings output parameters. The author states it changes no behavior. It is built on top of two other still-open PRs, #25665 (adds Result failure types) and #26022 (adds ResultPtr), and touches 44 files across wallet, kernel boundary code, node/chainstate, and util/result.h itself.
result.problem: Wallet loading code up and down the stack returns error and warning information in inconsistent ways (status enums plus output reference parameters), making the interfaces awkward to use and extend. This creates friction for anyone maintaining or adding to wallet loading, database creation, or the kernel/node error-reporting boundary.

open_concerns: sedited (2023-06-19) asked how the design handles Result types whose value type itself has an operator bool(), e.g. Result<optional<int>>, arguing the non-presence of a value is not always an error; ryanofsky agreed disallowing bool-convertible T by default was the right direction (2023-07-20) but that fix has not been implemented in the current code.

martinus's design nits about Construct() clarity, noexcept move constructors, and forbidding bool as T were mostly addressed, but the noexcept move-constructor point was explicitly deferred as a future optimization rather than fixed.
resolved_concerns: martinus's naming and clarity suggestions on util::Result (rename Fn to Failure, delete move-assignment operator, add static_assert on sizeof) were implemented by the author in the 2023-05-02 push.
maflcko's August 2023 suggestion to mark the PR draft while CI is red and it is based on unmerged work was accepted; the PR remains draft.

result.card: This PR converts wallet loading functions (CreateWallet, LoadWallet, RestoreWallet, MakeDatabase, MakeSQLiteDatabase, DumpWallet, and related RPC/interfaces code) to uniformly return util::Result instead of scattered error/warning output parameters, with the author stating no behavior change. It is stacked on two other still-open PRs (#25665, #26022) that add the underlying Result failure-value and ResultPtr features, and has been force-pushed over 40 times across more than three years chasing conflicts with nearly every merged wallet PR. martinus gave a substantive Changes Requested review of the core Result mechanism that the author addressed, but sedited's concern about Result types convertible to bool (e.g. optional<T>) being error-prone remains unimplemented, and no reviewer has commented since August 2023. The PR is currently unrebased with a dirty merge state, so review right now risks being invalidated by the next required rebase. Its value is primarily consistency and maintainability across wallet loading and the kernel error-propagation boundary, not a stated bug fix, security fix, or user-facing feature.
